newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht quiet late, seen cautious after float.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht quiet late, seen cautious after float.

text.p: The Thai baht remained in a narrow range against the dollar late on Thursday as players remained sidelined to digest the new floating foreign exchange system, dealers said.
They said the baht/dollar trade will remain cautious for the next few days before market players begin to take some action.
"Interbank players would remain sidelined for the next few days. We want more time to study the new system," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht was quoted at 28.25/28.65 late in the domestic market and 29.00/29.50 in the offshore market.
The Bank of Thailand set its first daily reference rate at 27.383 per dollar.
Financial authorities made a surprise move on Wednesday when they adopt a managed float after 13 yeras of pegging it to a dollar-dominated basket of currencies.
With the two-tiered foreign exchange market still in place, the baht trading would still be limited, dealers said.
The baht/dollar one-month swap premium was quoted at 26/36 satangs per dollar late in the onshore market and 30/80 satangs in offshore markets.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 25-27 percent in late trade from 28-32 in the morning.
"The liquidity is likely to improve further tomorrow as some lenders may lend their surplus funds to earn high interest rates," said one money market dealer.
